layout:
<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<Page>
  
  
  <Header role="banner" contains="logo,search,nav,profileMenu" sticky="true"/>
  
  
  <Toolbar contains="toggleDetails,darkModeSwitch" position="top"/>
  
  
  <MainContent layout="threeColumn">
    
    
    <Card title="My Recently Viewed" type="list" itemType="document" position="left"/>
    
    
    <Column position="center">
      
      
      <Card title="My Most Viewed Favourites" type="list" itemType="document" hasViewAll="true"/>
      
      
      <Card title="Recently Updated Pages" type="list" itemType="document"/>
      
    
    </Column>
    
    
    <Card title="Recent Activity" type="activityFeed" position="right"/>
    
  
  </MainContent>
  

</Page>
description: Displays recent activity, favorites, and updates in a clean, card-based layout.

layout:
<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<Page>
  
  
  <Header appName="BookStack" role="navigation" contains="search,mainMenu,userMenu"/>
  
  
  <Breadcrumb hasPath="true" currentPage="Page Template"/>
  
  
  <Sidebar role="actions" visible="true">
    
    
    <DetailsPanel contains="revisionInfo,createdBy,updatedBy"/>
    
    
    <ActionsList contains="edit,copy,move,revisions,permissions,delete,watch,favourite,export"/>
    
  
  </Sidebar>
  
  
  <MainContent>
    
    
    <PageTitle text="Page Template"/>
    
    
    <PageDescription text="Page Description Template"/>
    
  
  </MainContent>
  
  
  <FooterNavigation contains="previous,next" itemType="chapter,page"/>
  

</Page>
description: Displays book page details, actions, and navigation; clean, minimal, and editable state.
prev_action: From the dashboard click 'Page Template' link
In the 'Leave a comment here' field, type 'I like this template'
